summary: Reproduced at c3049627ea2c. A GatedMLP with pad_to=1, hidden 128 and intermediate 129, run on one FP16 token, produced output matching down(a) where the last intermediate element is left as the raw up value (max abs diff 0.0046, FP16 rounding) and not the correct down(silu(gate) * up) (diff 0.82): the activation kernel processed 64 half2 pairs and skipped the 129th element.
what_ran: repro.py writes a tiny random checkpoint with one gate/up/down triple (128 -> 129 -> 128), constructs exllamav3.modules.GatedMLP directly with pad_to=1 and interm/out dtype half, loads it unquantized on physical GPU 1, forwards one token, and compares with two torch references from the same weights. Environment py312-superset-torch26cu126.
limits: silu only (gelu_mul not run); one odd size. No in-tree constructor uses pad_to=1.
